Academic Services

  • Home
  • Academic Services

Ensuring your academic success

Individual student support at Cal Lutheran goes well beyond the classroom. We offer a variety of programs, resources and services to help you succeed and earn your degree.

Academic Calendars

View full calendar

    Announcements

    • Graduation: Fall 2026 to Summer 2027

      If you are planning to complete your degree requirements during the 2026-2027 Academic Year (August 24, 2026 through August 13, 2027), please apply to graduate online through your MyCLU portal.  

    • New Degree Dates

      Exciting news for our graduates! We are now awarding degrees at the end of every term or semester, rather than the 5 designated dates previously. What does this means for you? Faster posting of your degree to your academic record and shorter waiting time to get your diploma!
